title: Solana Price Analysis: Key Levels And Weekend Outlook
description:
Solana continues to follow Bitcoin higher but is significantly weaker. Bitcoin has already broken above the March highs while Solana would still need a 12 percent move just to get there. In this video I walk through the SOL BTC ratio chart, explain why Solana is being outperformed, show you the Fibonacci target zone between 110 and 138 dollars, and break down two short term pathways with key support and resistance levels.


Timestamps:
00:00 Solana Bouncing Into Resistance
00:30 Still Underperforming Bitcoin On The Ratio Charts
01:00 First Resistance Zone: 86.37 To 88.30 Dollars
01:30 White Scenario: Five Waves Down, This Is A Wave Two Bounce
02:00 Target For Third Wave Decline: Blue Zone 79 To 81
02:30 Green Line At 89.40: Key Level For The Bulls
03:00 Orange Scenario: Direct C Wave Breakout
03:15 Why Three Waves Up Does Not Confirm A Trend
03:38 The Diagonal Pattern You Cannot Trust
04:00 Break Above 88.30 Shifts Probabilities
04:15 Break Below 85 First Signal Of Third Wave Down
04:30 Both Scenarios Still Allow Higher Prices Eventually

We are going to take a look at this in this video. Because the market has been in a rather weak uptre weak uptrend but still a local uptrend yeah from the april low just like bitcoin um bitcoin moved up i think more than thirty percent from the march low uh solana less yeah less so so that is very evident we i showed you in yesterday's video a couple of days ago i showed SolBTC chart, so they are still going down which means Solana is being outperformed by Bitcoin. Of course still, Solana is kind of following Bitcoin in direction, but it means that if Bitcoin goes down a little bit, Solana is going down more, and if Bitcoin goes up, Solana is going up less the very first resistance I'm tracking here on the Sol chart is the $86.37.30 to $88.30 area this is the nearest resistance zone to watch the market is currently testing this own and we have a possible five wave decline from the April high so this could just be a 5 wave decline from April high. This could be a wave 1 down and we are moving up in a wave 2. This can be a regular 1 and 2 set up to the downside which could lead to a 3rd wave decline which is often the most rapid in a cycle. This could also be a four and a five. so based on this white scenario the market could therefore be working on a larger degree wave too. as long as the market now stays below the green line at 89 dollars, and 41 the idea is that the market goes down a little bit lower could test the blue zone down here between 7979 and $81 and then start a recovery rally from there in a third wave. The nearest resistance I already mentioned is between $86 and $38 and $88.30 and this is the very first zone where the bulls could start to struggle. Please note, we have a five-wave Notice that the five wave decline is looking correct. There is nothing indicating a direct breakout. That can change if we see an increase in upside in resistance, which is what we should not see in the white count, then the orange will become more likely. In the orange scenario however we would be dealing with a C wave up most likely but bear in mind the move up from the low here on the 19th of April the Sunday low it really is only a three wave move up and so with a three wave move we don't really have a trend confirmation everything here is really just corrective in nature, yeah? So just three-wave movements to the upset all the time. So I can't rule out that we go up further, but if you believe that, then the only key level I can offer here as support for this scenario is the Sunday low at $83. Please note that a three-wave move up doesn't really inspire much confidence because a three wave move is not a trending move. But it's possible we go up higher. It's just not very clean pattern, and it would require further evidence like for example a break above resistance in the first stage. So that would be a break above $88.30. Hasn't happened yet. If that happens, I would argue it becomes also more probable that we are going to see a break above our green line here and then upside continuation in the C-wave, but if that C-wave plays out as per this orange scenario, it is likely just a diagonal structure yeah and this is scenario you can't trust so this would be a wave one a wave to wave three four or five in wave sea of three but it doesn't look very clean because we have three waves up and five waves down. And this does not really, yeah that's not really a good combination for the bulls. So my view is, you know, lower, like, as long as we stay below $88.30 Above this level, probabilities will start to shift. Please note, in both of these presented scenarios, higher prices are still possible and probable and expected. But we just have to keep the door open for a bit of a deeper pull back into the blue zone, especially if we see some weakness over the weekend that would become confirmed. First indication we're going lower in the third wave would be a break below this last low at $85. yeah and if you're interested in the bigger picture I recommend that you check out yesterday's video in which I covered the bigger picture in great detail so hope you like the update if you did please hit the like button leave a comment and subscribe and if you're interested in additional updates check out our membership I put the link into the comments for you thanks so much bye
